title: Pahlavan data schema v1
description: The files in the Pahlavan data folder: profile.json, program.json, log/<YYYY-MM>.json, checkins.json, body.json, ledger.json, checkins.json (the coach's check-in log), tracking.json, nudges.json, sitting.json and eating-plan.json. Each carries schemaVersion 1. Also the phone's inbox entries (Coach/Inbox/*.json), which carry the entry version v 1 instead. Keys starting with _ are comments. Written by hand to match src/core/schema.ts and src/core/validate.ts; cross-file and cross-field checks live in the validator.

date.description: A real calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (the validator also rejects dates like 2026-02-30).

repRange.description: [lo, hi] reps; the validator also checks lo <= hi.

rateBand.description: A signed weekly change; pct is a fraction of body weight. The validator also checks lo <= hi.

shortSessions.description: Some of the week's days are shorter: how many, and their minutes.

travelEquipment.description: What travel usually offers, in the same words as equipment. The Hotel version of a session uses only these and bodyweight; without the list, bodyweight, dumbbells and bands.

selfCheck.description: The intake's movement self-check, with its date (read by engine 0.6.0 and later).

sitToStand.description: Five slow reps to a knee-height box: easy or not, heels down or lifting.

coreHold.description: A front plank or a hollow hold, seconds.

overheadReach.description: Arms straight up against a wall: clean, or with the ribs flaring or the lower back arching (a clean reach has neither; the validator checks it).

badWeek.description: What usually happens when a week goes badly.

pair.description: Done as a superset with the slot before it: a set of each, then rest.

exercise.description: A strength exercise (kind strength or absent) needs a unit and an increment.

program.description: program.json. The validator also checks that every slot's exercise, swaps and until.exercise exist in `exercises`.

hotel.description: Done as the Hotel version: counts for adherence and the week's sets, never for a lift's e1RM trend, stall check or next target.

skipWhy.description: Why a skipped item was skipped, by exercise id (a key of skipped).

session.description: The validator also checks that a Light session logs no sets, that plan.template equals template and that every skipWhy key is in skipped.

sessionPain.description: A pain logged with a session (the Log panel's "Any pain or niggle?").

log.description: log/<YYYY-MM>.json. The validator also checks that every session falls in `month` and that ids are unique.

soreMuscles.description: Sore muscles on the morning body map, by muscle id.

proteinExtra.description: The unticked days the Sunday check-in says reached the protein target; the week's protein days are its ticks plus these, at most 7.

pattern.description: The eating plan's weekly pattern: met (true) or not (false), by the line's id.

weeklyCheckin.description: A weekly check-in (checkin.md). weekStart (or the first-v1 weekOf) is the reviewed week's Monday; in checkins.json date and weekStart are required. The validator checks Mondays, dates after the check-in, and one record per date.

checkins.description: checkins.json. The validator also checks that daily dates are unique.

body.description: body.json. The validator also checks that weigh-in dates are unique.

splitPreferences.description: Splits the user has liked or disliked before.

slotProgression.description: linear: add `step` every session the reps are made; double: the rep range, then the step; wave: double with the RIR set week by week; ladder: the top of the range on every set, then the `next` variation (`ladder` and `level`: the calisthenics ladder and the 1-based level the slot starts at).

ledgerConstraint.description: One Ledger entry's constraint: abdominal-strain tags or movements ruled out, in force through until (inclusive).

ledger.description: ledger.json, the machine-readable twin of the coach's Ledger. The validator also checks that constraint ids are unique.

jointAche.description: A pain or niggle reported at the check-in. Over 3/10, or lingering, it counts as a fatigue sign.

knownBusy.description: A known busy period ahead. The validator also checks from <= to.

triageRecord.description: The stall triage step a letter applied to a lift.

unloggedSession.description: A session done but not logged, confirmed at the check-in.

checkinDeload.description: cancelled: the user cancels the deload in the week after the check-in. trainedAtFullLoad: Mondays of dashboard deload weeks trained at full load.

checkinLog.description: Coach/checkins.json: the weekly check-in records, one per check-in date.

rirCalibration.description: One RIR calibration set; bias = actual - predicted.

waistDropCm.description: [lo, hi]: a drop from the cycle's first value, the stretch at hi.

weightDropKg.description: [lo, hi]: a drop from the cycle's first value, the stretch at hi.

rhrDropBpm.description: [lo, hi]: a drop from the cycle's first value, the stretch at hi.

targets.description: Profile targets: the numbers Progress measures against (week 24).

timestamp.description: A moment in UTC, as an ISO timestamp.

deskStep.description: One step of a desk-break routine.

deskBreaks.description: The plan's desk breaks: a routine every `every` minutes between from and to on the listed days.

itemSchedule.description: Which days an item is due. days for weekdays; n (and from) for every N days.

itemReminder.description: The item's reminder card; which keys apply depends on the kind (validator).

itemVersion.description: An item's earlier settings, in force through until.

trackedItem.description: One tracked item. Its kind decides which settings it needs (validator).

deskMinutes.description: Stand-ups: of `minutes`, the minutes logged as desk stands ("Standing now"); the rest came from the stand-up card.

itemDay.description: One item's record for one day.

tracking.description: Coach/tracking.json: what is tracked, each item's log by day, the coach's suggestions and the check-in reminders.

nudgeEntry.description: One reminder's state on one day.

nudges.description: Coach/nudges.json: reminder state per day and reminder key, shared by every Mac, and the body-record occurrences skipped.

sittingLog.description: Coach/sitting.json: sitting stretches per local day and per Mac.

gramRange.description: [low, high], above 0; the validator also checks low <= high.

proteinRange.description: [low, high] grams of protein, 0 or more; the validator also checks low <= high.

handRange.description: [low, high] hands, whole numbers; the validator also checks low <= high.

nonNegRange.description: [low, high], 0 or more; the validator also checks low <= high.

storedReason.description: A reason as the coach kept it when the plan was made.

eatingBasis.description: The trend weight the grams were set from, its date and how many weigh-ins it rested on.

eatingProtein.description: The day's floor (the protein item is ticked at it; inside rangeG, validator), the range, its g per kg, a meal's share, the tracked item and its card's time.

eatingEnergy.description: The coach's reference: shown only at the Standard and Full levels.

foods.description: The foods for each hand of the meal's portions, by food group id (validator).

eatingMeal.description: A meal with its rough protein; portions names its entry in the plan's portions (validator).

foodGroup.description: A food group of the plate guide, the hand that measures it and its words [one, many].

eatingFallbacks.description: For the meal the plan calls hardest (a meal id, validator).

patternLine.description: One line of the weekly pattern; min or max is required (validator).

adjustRule.description: The adjustment rule: what the tape and the weight trend change, one step at a time.

reasonSourceKind.description: Where a reason of the plan comes from: an intake answer ("From your intake") or the user's own words ("You said").

mealIdea.description: A concrete meal that fits; counts names the weekly pattern lines it helps (pattern ids, validator).

trainingNote.description: A line for the kind of day the meal changes: a lifting day, a short-session day.

clockPair.description: [from, to] local times; the validator also checks from <= to.

reasonSource.description: The intake answer or the user's words a reason comes from, with a line under it (aside).

planReason.description: One reason for the plan, shown under Why this plan.

trainingTime.description: When a session starts on the Food tab's day, and roughly how long.

dayTraining.description: The session's time by the kind of day the plan's rotation gives.

dayDrinks.description: The drinks line under the day.

eatingDay.description: The user's day as the Food tab's timeline draws it, with each meal's at.

optionalCheck.description: A light check on the Food tab's Today, never a score: it pre-fills the pattern line of the same id (validator) at the Sunday check-in.

eatingToday.description: The Food tab's Today: the light checks.

coachTip.description: One of the coach's tips, with what it helps (a meal id, pattern.fish, looseDay).

eatingPlan.description: Coach/eating-plan.json: the eating plan, the twin of Coach/Eating plan.md. The validator also checks the review is not before updated, the floor is inside the range, the ids are unique and every reference resolves.

inboxAt.description: When the phone sent an entry: ISO 8601 with the phone's offset, as Shortcuts formats it (2026-11-05T19:02:00-05:00), or in UTC.

inboxLift.description: A logged lift's top set, as the log takes it; the unit, when left out, is the lift's own in the plan.

inboxSessionFields.description: A session from the phone: one of the plan's session types, its two logged lifts' top sets in the plan's order (lifting days only), and the Log panel's quick fields.

steps.description: Yesterday's: filed under the day before, as the morning card files it.

weightUnit.description: The weight's unit; kg when left out (body-data.json holds kg).

inboxMorningFields.description: The morning check-in's fields under body-data.json's names, with the morning card's limits; at least one. The validator also checks the weight's range in kg.

inboxTick.description: Supplements and ticks done (or, with done false, undone) on the date.

add.description: Added to the day's amount (less than 0 takes some off, never below 0).

inboxAmount.description: An amount added to the day (water).

inboxTrained.description: The answer to "Did you train today?".

inboxEntry.description: One phone entry: one file in Coach/Inbox/, named <yyyy-MM-dd>T<HH-mm-ss>-<kind>.json, sent by the phone's shortcuts and applied by Pahlavan through its own writers.
